body: Your mid-turn message to "runtime.delivery_unread·to" has NOT been read yet — it has been waiting runtime.delivery_unread·waited in its steer store. Mid-turn mail is injected when the recipient's current tool call returns, and runtime.delivery_unread·to has been inside one call for 4s. Nothing is lost — it is delivered at that boundary, or at runtime.delivery_unread·to's next turn if the turn ends first. If it cannot wait that long, orgtree_interrupt (⏸) on runtime.delivery_unread·to creates a boundary immediately without ending its session.
